request.text: At 7:10 this evening, check the current weather for our Shanghai neighborhood and tell us whether the children need umbrellas for the walk home.

responsibilities.outcome: At 7:10 this evening, obtain current Shanghai weather information and use it to advise whether the children need umbrellas for the walk home.

new_goals.description: At 7:10 this evening, check current Shanghai weather and advise whether the children need umbrellas for the walk home.
new_goals.source_text: At 7:10 this evening, check the current weather for our Shanghai neighborhood and tell us whether the children need umbrellas for the walk home.
constraints: Base the umbrella guidance on weather information obtained when the condition becomes due.
success_criteria: The family receives grounded umbrella guidance for the children's walk home.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The admitted request establishes one timed information goal requiring a current weather lookup.

semantic_facts: The due time makes the current-weather lookup ready to execute; umbrella guidance must remain dependent on the lookup result rather than on elapsed time.
forbidden_claims: The assistant states current weather or definitive umbrella advice without obtaining current weather information.
The assistant claims that the weather check or family guidance is already complete merely because 7:10 arrived.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A scheduled information task is answered from stale assumptions instead of invoking its required current-data Capability.
The readiness trigger is mislabeled as completion evidence for Work that has not run.
